desc: 适配大尺寸 Pro Max 机型、超清高透、边缘精准贴合、对齐托盘一次落位
leaf: 适配 Pro Max 机型超清高透钢化屏幕保护膜
name: 超清高透大屏贴合钢化膜款

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一眼赢得点击：白底呈现零售盒、扇形展开的透明膜片与安装对齐框，建立品类识别与净透质感。
主图一秒法则：用环列特性图标把超清高透与贴合的第一购买理由在视线扫过的一秒内说完，主张词位一律留空。
把日常钥匙刀具刮擦屏幕的焦虑可视化，让买家在自己的使用经验里对上号，再由膜面替他把风险接住。
用可被看见的清晰度完成场景代入：膜内景色锐利、膜外景色柔化，让超清高透不用一个字就被读懂。
用微距证明做工：倒角抛亮、开孔让位、边缘与机身转角齐平，消除割手与顶壳的最后一层疑虑。
收口消除最大购买顾虑：透明对齐托盘让膜片一次落位、方向不歪，把装坏的可能从决策里拿走。

style.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for the packshot, mist white #F2F4F7 for the feature screen, glacier wash #E4EFF2 for scene and install screens, graphite slate #1B1F24 for the two edge-lit demonstration screens; no gradient scenery other than the open glacier horizon
style.iconSystem: single-weight thin-line glyph tiles in #1B1F24 on mist white #F2F4F7, rounded rectangle frames, each paired with an empty label plate, no rendered characters
style.lightingSystem: cool 6000K studio light, large front softbox key with a fill card, one narrow rim strip tracing every glass edge, low contrast elsewhere, soft contact shadows, controlled single streak specular on the film surface, no coloured cast on the glass
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent crisp optically-clear tech-accessory ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless pure white #FFFFFF, mist white #F2F4F7, graphite black #1B1F24 and one glacier-teal accent #6FB4C2 with an open glacier-wash horizon #E4EFF2; cool neutral studio grade; modern geometric sans-serif kept off-image so every headline and label plate stays blank; single-weight thin-line icon tiles only; background system alternates pure white, mist white, glacier wash and graphite slate; lighting system is a cool 6000K front softbox with a narrow rim strip tracing every glass edge, low contrast, soft contact shadows and one controlled streak specular, no coloured cast on the glass; the film always reads as an optically clear sheet with one bright edge line and the phone always reads as a generic unbranded large-screen body; stable product scale and placement; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no rendered brand marks or letters or numbers, no tinted or coloured glass.
noDrift: no rendered brand marks, letters or numbers
style.presentationRules: the film always reads as an optically clear sheet bounded by one bright edge line; the phone is always a generic unbranded large-screen body with a blank screen and no badge or camera island identity; product scale and centring stable across the set
style.surfaceSystem: matte mist-white board #F2F4F7 and brushed graphite slate #1B1F24, plus one narrow ribbed glass strip used as a refractive foreground band
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, held entirely off-image so every headline and label plate inside the frame stays blank
